explanation: Antihydra: a_0 = 8, a_{n+1} = ⌊3a_n/2⌋ = a_n + ⌊a_n/2⌋, as on the wiki. b_n = 2·#even − #odd among a_0..a_{n−1}, so ∀n, b_n ≥ 0 says there are never more than twice as many odd as even terms. This is the conjectured non-halting answer to the wiki's question. The statement is faithful and open.
